none: PAS NCL-DF5467: Stone weight of the Roman to Modern periods
contea di ritrovamento: County Durham (Inghilterra e Galles)

A probable weight made of chipped stone of the Roman to Modern periods. The stone is discoid with rounds sides and a central perforation. On one fact, a slight inscribed line cross the perforation, perhaps indicating a resting place for a brace or pin related to the shaft or rope that passed through the perforation. The stone is a loose sandstone and relatively light in weight. If not a stone…
